u0: Normal, no-pending-fall state: the box is normally in hand at the start and after any successful recovery, and no fall is currently awaiting pickup. Next objective: move toward the exit. If the box falls, immediate recovery becomes the priority and the machine moves to u1.
u1: Immediate-recovery state: the box has just slipped from the agent's hands and is on the floor, so it is not currently held. Pick it up on this very next step to return to u0 with the preferred recovery credit; if it is not held after this step, the state degrades to u2. Reaching the exit still terminates successfully.
u2: Late-recovery state: the box is on the floor and the one-step immediate-pickup window has been missed. Recover it later if practical; doing so returns to u0 with reduced recovery credit. Otherwise, continue toward the exit, which still terminates the episode.
uF: Terminal success state: the agent has reached the exit and the episode is over. No further movement, recovery, or exit objective remains.
